# 2. `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.md`

This is for someone suggesting a new feature or improvement.

```md
---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement for Symtab
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

# Feature Request

Thank you for suggesting an improvement to Symtab.

Before creating a feature request:

- Search existing issues and pull requests to make sure the idea has not already been proposed.
- Clearly explain the problem the feature would solve.
- Describe the proposed behavior rather than only naming the feature.

## Description

Provide a clear and concise description of the feature or improvement.

<!-- What would you like Symtab to support? -->

## Problem

What problem would this feature solve?

Explain the current limitation, difficulty, or use case that led to this request.

<!-- Example:
Currently, users cannot ...
This makes it difficult to ...
-->

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you think the feature should work.

Include details about:

- User interaction
- Expected behavior
- UI changes, if applicable
- Any relevant workflow

<!-- Describe the proposed solution here. -->

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions, existing features, or workarounds you considered.

<!-- What other approaches did you consider? -->

## Use Case

Explain who would benefit from this feature and when it would be useful.

<!-- Describe a practical example of how this feature would be used. -->

## Screenshots, Mockups, or References

If applicable, attach:

- Screenshots
- UI mockups
- Design references
- Example implementations
- Relevant documentation

<!-- Drag and drop images or files here. -->

## Additional Context

Add any other information that may help maintainers understand the proposal.

## Checklist

Before submitting this feature request, please confirm:

- [ ] I searched existing issues and pull requests for similar requests.
- [ ] I have clearly explained the problem this feature would solve.
- [ ] I have described the proposed solution.
- [ ] I have considered possible alternatives or workarounds.
- [ ] I have included relevant screenshots or references where applicable.
